items.title: Pincer-MCP – Stop AI agents from reading their own credentials
items.raw_excerpt:
I run AI agents for coding (OpenClaw, Claude Desktop) and realized they could read their own .env files. Tested it - asked my agent to "check configuration" and it printed everything. The problem: agents need file access to work, but if they can read files, they can read their own credentials. One prompt injection and your API keys are leaked. Standard solutions don't help:
- Environment variables: agent can read process.env
- Secret managers: agent needs credentials to access them
- Better prompting: can't security-patch an LLM with instructions I built a proxy token architecture instead. The agent never sees real credentials: - Agent has: pxr_abc123 (proxy token)
- Real keys: encrypted in OS keychain
- On API call: decrypt key, make call, scrub memory immediately Built in 1 week. 500 npm

- Level 2: Automated "doctor --fix" (config validation, port checks)
- Level 3: Claude Code spawns in tmux, reads logs, attempts repairs
- Level 4: Discord alert if all automation fails Production-tested in my homelab over 3 months: 99% recovery rate, recovery time reduced from 45min → 3min avg. Additionally, during the CCTV 2026 Spring Festival Gala on New Year's Eve, Doudou will offer over 100,000 tech gifts integrated with Doudou's large model and cash red envelopes to audiences nationwide.

The first phase begins at 8 PM on February 13, when users can enter the Doudou App's New Year event page to experience AI-generated greetings and other AI-themed activities, participating in draws for red envelopes that can be cashed out upon winning.

On New Year's Eve, February 16, Doudou will launch the second phase of the red envelope and tech gift draws during the CCTV Spring Festival Gala, synchronized with live interactive segments. That night, users will have three chances to win cash red envelopes of up to 8,888 yuan or tech gifts integrated with Doudou's large model.

Notably, the tech gifts also include the use rights of two electric vehicles: the SAIC Audi e-tron Sportback and the Mercedes-Benz CLA.

It's worth noting that all the tech prizes are deeply integrated with Doudou's large model capabilities. For instance, the Unitree robot to be given away during the CCTV Spring Festival Gala features human-like voice and tone generated by Doudou's large model.

excerpt_i18n.zh: 2025年1月——在AI技术从感知智能迈向认知智能的关键转折点上，质变科技正式发布了具备超大规模实践能力的多模态记忆平台——MemoryLake。该平台首次将“多模态内容深度理解、多模态记忆存储、记忆计算与管理”全栈能力融于一体，由 MemoryLake-D1 大模型、MemoryLake 记忆引擎和多模态存储与计算平台（Relyt Multi-modal Data Cloud）构成。MemoryLake 旨在解决当前企业AI落地面临的诸多根本挑战，包括“多模态信息难以理解与融合”“数据碎片化导致记忆断层”“模型决策不准确不可靠”“大模型调用成本高”“企业数据规模庞大却响应迟缓” 等痛点。这一产品的发布标志着AI基础设施正式从“以数据为中心”迈入“以记忆为中心”的新阶段。 认知计算范式演进：从处理数据到处理记忆 当前企业级AI应用普遍面临一个根本矛盾：大型语言模型具备强大的生成能力，却难以在复杂业务场景中给出准确、持续、可解释的行动级决策。根源在于，现有系统仍是围绕“数据”而构建，而非围绕“记忆”构建。正如质变科技CEO占超群所说：“传统计算系统处理的是行为记录，而记忆计算系统处理的是决策轨迹——这是智能体网络（Agent Network）的基础”。 从传统计算到认知计算，这一理念体现在三个根本性的范式转变上： 1.架构设计转向认知状态记忆为中心 认知状态记忆是一等公民（First-Class State），认知状态记忆是系统在某一时刻，对“我在做什么、我知道什么、我假设什么、我不确定什么”的结构化内部表征。 2.系统核心从“管理数据记录”转向“构建多模态认知状态记忆” 以多模态存储与计算平台为基石、大模型为数据深度理解引擎、支持高准确度和自演进的记忆管理与计算引擎为系统核心，未来技术竞争的关键在于记忆的多模态、准确性、可追溯、反思以及自演进能力。 3.基础设施转向记忆管理

This platform integrates for the first time comprehensive capabilities in "deep understanding of multi-modal content, multi-modal memory storage, and memory computation and management," comprising the MemoryLake-D1 large model, the MemoryLake memory engine, and the multi-modal storage and computing platform (Relyt Multi-modal Data Cloud). MemoryLake aims to address fundamental challenges in current enterprise AI implementation, including difficulties in understanding and integrating multi-modal information, memory fragmentation due to data fragmentation, inaccurate and unreliable model decisions, high costs of large model invocation, and slow responses despite vast corporate data volumes. excerpt_i18n.es: Enero de 2025 — En el punto de inflexión crucial donde la tecnología de IA pasa de la inteligencia perceptiva a la cognitiva, la empresa Zhibian Technology lanzó oficialmente MemoryLake, una plataforma de memoria multimodal con capacidades de gran escala. Esta plataforma integra por primera vez la comprensión profunda de contenido multimodal, el almacenamiento de memoria multimodal, y el cálculo y gestión de memoria en una única solución, compuesta por el gran modelo MemoryLake-D1, el motor de memoria MemoryLake y la plataforma de almacenamiento y cálculo multimodal (Relyt Multi-modal Data Cloud). MemoryLake tiene como objetivo resolver los desafíos actuales que enfrentan las empresas en la implementación de la IA.

excerpt_i18n.en:
On February 9, Baidu Intelligent Cloud officially launched the OpenClaw Rapid and Easy Deployment Solution. Developers can log in to the Baidu Intelligent Cloud official website, use the lightweight application server's visual configuration panel, and easily deploy OpenClaw, accelerating the process of transforming Agent applications from trial to practical use.

OpenClaw is an open-source AI Agent project that has quickly gained popularity in the global developer community, often referred to as a "digital employee that can command computers." It leverages large model capabilities and automates local environment and task processes through mechanisms such as file read/write, terminal execution, memory management, and multi-agent collaboration. However, for many non-professional developers, complex environment setup and model integration remain significant barriers.

The new easy deployment solution from Baidu Intelligent Cloud primarily addresses the "difficult deployment" issue. Developers simply need to select the pre-configured OpenClow image on the lightweight application server, and the system will automatically complete environment installation and service startup without manual dependency configuration. For model integration, developers just need to select the required model from a dropdown menu, and the platform will automatically create the Qianfan API Key and configure it within the instance.

In practical terms, the solution consolidates previously scattered processes like model integration, message platform configuration, and skill loading into visual steps, supporting on-demand activation of Feishu, DingTalk, and Enterprise WeChat.
excerpt_i18n.es:
El 9 de febrero, Baidu Intelligent Cloud lanzó oficialmente la versión de implementación rápida y sencilla de OpenClaw. Los desarrolladores pueden acceder al sitio web oficial de Baidu Intelligent Cloud y, mediante el panel de configuración visual del servidor de aplicaciones ligero, los usuarios pueden implementar rápidamente OpenClaw, acelerando el proceso de transformación de las aplicaciones de Agent de experiencia a uso práctico.

OpenClaw es un proyecto de código abierto de AI Agent que ha ganado popularidad rápidamente en la comunidad global de desarrolladores, siendo llamado por muchos usuarios "un empleado digital capaz de dirigir una computadora". Puede utilizar capacidades de grandes modelos y realizar tareas como lectura y escritura de archivos, ejecución de terminales, gestión de memoria y colaboración multiagente.

items.title: 中美AI应用的分岔路，出现在这个春节
items.raw_excerpt: 距离春节还有十天，AI大战提前进入了白热化。 而这次把战场迅速烧热的，是阿里的 AI 入口“千问”。 2月6日，千问上线“春节30亿大免单”活动，机制简单粗暴——请全国人民喝奶茶。活动期间，用户最高可领取21张、总价值525元的无门槛免单卡。 这绝非又一场“外卖大战”，而是一场 AI 办事能力的“大考”。当成千上万的用户涌进 AI 产品，让最先进的人工智能与最落地的烟火气相遇。 Agent 时代下，每个人的生活决策已经可以交由 AI 完成。硅谷巨头们正竞相构建面向企业系统的“数字员工”，试图让 AI 接管办公流中的繁琐环节；而在中国，Agent 的落点则更早地切入了充满烟火气的现实世界，开始替人点一杯奶茶、订一张车票。 这并非技术能力的代差，而是基于土壤不同的路径选择。 而千问，似乎要在帮人办事这条道路上，走得更深更远。 01 重新定义AI时代的抢红包 2026年春节前夕，AI战场的硝烟味比往年更甚。 字节的“豆包”依托春晚的独家赞助，试图用AI生成内容延续短视频时代的流量法则；腾讯的“元宝”则背靠微信生态，试图在社交连接中寻找AI的落点；百度依然固守搜索与信息分发阵地。 这三者的共同点在于，它们争夺的依然是用户的“注意力时长”。 其本质延续了移动互联网时代的经典公式：用更优质的内容或更顺滑的交互，去争夺用户有限的时间与多巴胺，让用户愿意在App里多停留一分钟。 相比之下，千问选择了一条更为艰难、也更为彻底的路径。 与其继续在红海中争夺“用户停留多久”，千问更在意的是：用户是否愿意把真实生活中的决策与执行，交给AI。 因此，千问并未沿用传统的现金红包，而是选择以“免单”切入春节场景。免单无法独立存在，它必须嵌入真实的消费决策与完整的服务链路之中——用户需要

excerpt_i18n.es: Aún faltan diez días para el Año Nuevo Lunar, pero la batalla de IA ya ha entrado en su fase más intensa. El responsable de caldear rápidamente el terreno ha sido el portal de IA de Alibaba, "Qwen". El 6 de febrero, Qwen lanzó la campaña "3000 millones de yuanes en descuentos para el Año Nuevo", con un concepto simple: invitar a todo el país a tomar té de leche. Durante el evento, los usuarios pueden obtener hasta 21 cupones gratuitos, con un valor total de 525 yuanes. Esto no es otra guerra del delivery, sino una gran prueba de las capacidades prácticas de la IA. Cuando miles de usuarios se sumergen en productos de IA, se produce un encuentro entre la inteligencia artificial más avanzada y la vida cotidiana más real.

items.title: 动易科技智造中心落地广州，具身智能体 PHYBOT C2 量产 + 核心系统开源双发
items.raw_excerpt: 2026 年 2 月 6 日，动易科技创始人兼 CEO 任晓雨在广州海珠创意产业园举办的发布会上，正式宣布企业智造中心落地广州。 此次选择广州落地智造中心，是经过多重考量的战略决策。广州不仅紧跟广东省两大产业行动号召，更拥有高度集聚的机器人与人工智能产业生态，能实现研发成果从图纸到实物的高效转化，大幅降低量产试错成本，完美适配企业从创新技术向产业化落地的关键阶段需求。 此次发布会亮点纷呈，除智造中心布局外，动易科技具身智能体PHYBOT C2 （以下简称C2）宣布量产，核心运动控制智能体 PhyCore 0.1 更是迎来全球永久免费开源。 2024 年 9 月成立的动易科技，自诞生之初便以 “Robot for AI” 为核心愿景，聚焦新一代通用具身智能体研发。 他们试图回答的是 AGI 时代一个根本性问题：当人工智能拥有了卓越的认知与思考能力，我们该为其配备怎样的“身躯”，去真实地感知并改变物理世界？   C2 量产上市：有温度的智能服务生 本次发布会的核心亮点，当属动易科技具身智能体 C2 的正式量产，C2 可谓是动易科技硬件实力的集大成。 C2 拥有 5KG 的双臂负载，相较同尺寸产品领先约 66.7%；4M/S 的移动速度，实现同级别 100% 领先；244N・m 的高关节扭矩密度，让机器人兼具敏捷性与稳定性。 这一系列核心参数，使其能轻松适应餐厅、展厅等复杂场景，高效完成端茶递物、整理桌椅、智能导览等轻量级体力与服务任务。 任晓雨将 C2 定义为 “有温度的智能服务生”，并强调：“我们坚持‘科技感与亲和力兼备’。C2不止要能干，更要让人愿意靠近。” 这份独有的 “温度”，源于 C2 业内领先的情感交互能力 —— 其头部搭载的双目 RGB 传感器与投影模块，能通过动态光影和画面变化表达简单 “情绪”，让人机交互从冰冷的指令回复，升级为更具人情味的

title_i18n.en: Dongyi Technology's Smart Manufacturing Center is established in Guangzhou, launching the mass production of the embodied intelligent agent PHYBOT C2 and the open-source release of its core system.
title_i18n.es: El centro de fabricación inteligente de Dongyi Technology se establece en Guangzhou, lanzando la producción en masa del androide físico PHYBOT C2 y la apertura del código fuente del sistema central.

excerpt_i18n.zh: 2026 年 2 月 6 日，动易科技创始人兼 CEO 任晓雨在广州海珠创意产业园举办的发布会上，正式宣布企业智造中心落地广州。 此次选择广州落地智造中心，是经过多重考量的战略决策。广州不仅紧跟广东省两大产业行动号召，更拥有高度集聚的机器人与人工智能产业生态，能实现研发成果从图纸到实物的高效转化，大幅降低量产试错成本，完美适配企业从创新技术向产业化落地的关键阶段需求。 此次发布会亮点纷呈，除智造中心布局外，动易科技具身智能体PHYBOT C2 （以下简称C2）宣布量产，核心运动控制智能体 PhyCore 0.1 更是迎来全球永久免费开源。 2024 年 9 月成立的动易科技，自诞生之初便以 “Robot for AI” 为核心愿景，聚焦新一代通用具身智能体研发。 他们试图回答的是 AGI 时代一个根本性问题：当人工智能拥有了卓越的认知与思考能力，我们该为其配备怎样的“身躯”，去真实地感知并改变物理世界？   C2 量产上市：有温度的智能服务生 本次发布会的核心亮点，当属动易科技具身智能体 C2 的正式量产，C2 可谓是动易科技硬件实力的集大成。 C2 拥有 5KG 的双臂负载，相较同尺寸产品领先约 66.7%；4M/S 的移动速度，实现同级别 100% 领先；244N・m 的高关节扭矩密度，让机器人兼具敏捷性与稳定性。 这一系列核心参数，使其能轻松适应餐厅、展厅等复杂场景，高效完成端茶递物、整理桌椅、智能导览等轻量级体力与服务任务。 任晓雨将 C2 定义为 “有温度的智能服务生”，并强调：“我们坚持‘科技感与亲和力兼备’。C2不止要能干，更要让人愿意靠近。” 这份独有的 “温度”，源于 C2 业内领先的情感交互能力 —— 其头部搭载的双目 RGB 传感器与投影模块，能通过动态光影和画面变化表达简单 “情绪”，让人机交互从冰冷的指令回复，升级为更具人情味的
excerpt_i18n.en:
On February 6, 2026, Ren Xiaoyu, founder and CEO of Dongyi Technology, officially announced the establishment of the company's manufacturing center in Guangzhou at a launch event held in the Haizhu Creative Industry Park. The decision to locate the manufacturing center in Guangzhou was a strategic choice based on multiple considerations. Guangzhou not only aligns with the two major industrial initiatives of Guangdong Province but also boasts a highly concentrated robotics and artificial intelligence industry ecosystem. This enables efficient conversion of research and development outcomes from concept to product, significantly reducing mass production trial costs, and perfectly meets the critical needs of enterprises transitioning from innovative technology to industrialization.

The launch event featured several highlights, including the layout of the manufacturing center and the announcement of the mass production of Dongyi Technology's embodied intelligent agent, PHYBOT C2 (hereinafter referred to as C2). Additionally, the core motion control intelligent agent PhyCore 0.1 was made globally and permanently open-source.

Founded in September 2024, Dongyi Technology has had a core vision of "Robot for AI" since its inception, focusing on the development of next-generation general-purpose embodied intelligent agents. They aim to address a fundamental question in the AGI era: when artificial intelligence possesses excellent cognitive and thinking abilities, what kind of "body" should be equipped to genuinely perceive and alter the physical world?

C2 Mass Production Launch: A Warm and Intelligent Server

The highlight of the launch event was the official mass production of Dongyi Technology's embodied intelligent agent, C2, which showcases the company's hardware capabilities. C2 has a payload capacity of 5KG.
excerpt_i18n.es: El 6 de febrero de 2026, Ren Xiaoyu, fundador y CEO de Dongyi Technology, anunció oficialmente en una conferencia de prensa celebrada en el Parque Industrial de Creatividad de Haizhu, Guangzhou, que el centro de fabricación inteligente de la empresa se establecería en Guangzhou. Esta decisión estratégica de establecer el centro en Guangzhou se tomó tras múltiples consideraciones. Guangzhou no solo sigue las dos principales iniciativas industriales de la provincia de Guangdong, sino que también cuenta con un ecosistema altamente concentrado de robótica y tecnología de inteligencia artificial, lo que permite una conversión eficiente de los resultados de investigación de los planos a productos físicos, reduciendo significativamente los costos de prueba en producción a gran escala y adaptándose perfectamente a las necesidades cruciales de la empresa en su etapa de transición de innovación tecnológica a industrialización. La conferencia de prensa estuvo llena de puntos destacados, incluyendo el anuncio del centro de fabricación inteligente y la presentación del robot físico PHYBOT de Dongyi Technology.
